module.name: Product visibility rules
module.description: Limits which products an administrator role sees by the products’ catalogue prices, and lets a sales channel’s products follow a configurable rule.
settingLabels.product_visibility_rules.m: On: mapped roles see only their category’s products; unmapped quote handlers see none. Off: no restriction.
actions.openProductVisibility.label: Product visibility rules
actions.openProductVisibility.descriptio: Map admin roles to visibility categories and choose each currency's catalogue price book
actions.openProductVisibility.keywords: visibility, categories, catalogue price, role mapping
errors.VISIBILITY_CATEGORY_IN_USE: Roles are mapped to this visibility category. Map them elsewhere before deleting it.
errors.ROLE_NOT_MAPPABLE: This role always sees every product, so it cannot be mapped.
errors.DESIGNATION_INVALID: This price book cannot set the currency's catalogue price: it must be a regular price book for everyone, in this currency, assigned to the chosen sales channel.
errors.PRODUCT_RULE_ATTACHED: This product rule governs a sales channel. Detach it from every sales channel before deleting it.
errors.WEBSITE_RULE_PREVIEW_REQUIRED: This product rule governs a sales channel, so its conditions change only through a preview. Preview the change and confirm it.
errors.WEBSITE_RULE_PREVIEW_LIMIT: Too many previews are waiting. Confirm or let an earlier preview expire, then try again.
errors.WEBSITE_RULE_PREVIEW_STALE: This preview is no longer current: it expired, is not ready yet, or the rule changed since. Create a new preview.
errors.CHANNEL_ALREADY_GOVERNED: This sales channel already follows another product rule. Detach that rule first.
